spec: leftmost_index(arr: list[int], x: int) -> int. arr is sorted ascending. Return the smallest index i with arr[i] == x, or -1 if x is not present.
reference_solution:
def leftmost_index(arr, x):
    import bisect
    i = bisect.bisect_left(arr, x)
    return i if i < len(arr) and arr[i] == x else -1
